senses.definition: In every part of; all through.
senses.example: And though a philosopher may live remote from business, the genius of philosophy, if carefully cultivated by several, must gradually diffuse itself throughout the whole society.

senses.definition: Completely through, right the way through.
senses.example: His spere went clene thrughout hys body, and so he fell downe deed.
The apartment is parqueted throughout except for the kitchen and bathroom.

senses.definition: During an entire period of time, the whole time.
senses.example: The fight was excrutiating. Throughout, we maintained our dignity though.

senses.definition: Of an ordinary such as a pile or chevron, or a partition per chevron, etc: extending to the edge of the field (or quarter, chief, etc).
senses.example: Thus the VON VÖLCKER of Frankfurt bear : Argent, a rose gules, the field embrassé à senestre of the second. We should blazon this : Gules, a pile throughout issuing from the dexter flank, charged with a rose of the field.
